checks.name: Administrator selects another account and a registered node
Gateway group supports manual IPv4/IPv6 subnet rows and editing
Custom device type can be created and renamed
Search is explicit; creating outside current filters resets them and expands the new direct device
Grouped device accepts a subnet mismatch with visible warning; multiple service lists stay expanded
Service CRUD uses real API; dual protocols, HTTP link, icon, and conflict handling
Device editing preserves ownership; reopening a collapsed service panel does not reopen an old add dialog
Referenced groups and types cannot be deleted
Chinese desktop and 390px screenshots show the saved data and service form
An offline registered node accepts manual device and service management
Service delete and device cascade delete persist; empty group and unused type can then be deleted
Responsive layout has no document-wide horizontal overflow
